description: This Swift source file defines a SwiftUI View named `VoiceWakeSettings`, which provides a user interface for configuring voice wake settings, microphone selection, recognition language, trigger words, alert sounds, and test controls for a voice wake feature in a macOS app.

classes.name: VoiceWakeSettings
classes.description: A SwiftUI View that allows users to configure voice wake options including microphone selection, language, trigger words, sounds, and testing controls.

classes.name: AudioInputDevice
classes.description: A struct representing an audio input device, identified by a UID and a name.

classes.name: TriggerEntry
classes.description: A struct representing a trigger word entry, with a UUID and the trigger word string.

methods.name: loadTriggerEntries
methods.description: Loads trigger words from the app state into the local triggerEntries array.

methods.name: syncTriggerEntriesToState
methods.description: Synchronizes local triggerEntries back to the app state's swabbleTriggerWords array.

methods.name: addWord
methods.description: Adds a new empty trigger word entry.

methods.name: removeWord
methods.description: Removes a trigger word entry by ID.

methods.name: toggleTest
methods.description: Starts or stops the voice wake test, updating test state and handling timeouts.

methods.name: chimeRow
methods.description: Creates a UI row for selecting a chime sound for trigger or send sounds.

methods.name: chooseCustomChime
methods.description: Opens a file dialog for selecting a custom chime sound file.

methods.name: selectChime
methods.description: Sets the chime selection and plays the chosen sound.

methods.name: sanitizedTriggers
methods.description: Returns the list of sanitized trigger words.

methods.name: textOnlyCommand
methods.description: Converts a transcript to a command string if it contains a trigger word.

methods.name: loadMicsIfNeeded
methods.description: Loads audio input devices (microphones) if not already loaded or forced.

methods.name: updateSelectedMicName
methods.description: Updates the app state with the name of the currently selected microphone.

methods.name: scheduleMicRefresh
methods.description: Schedules a refresh of microphone device list.

methods.name: loadLocalesIfNeeded
methods.description: Loads supported speech recognition locales if not already loaded.

methods.name: friendlyName
methods.description: Returns a user-friendly name for a locale.

methods.name: restartMeter
methods.description: Restarts the microphone input level meter and updates the level display.
